versions.content: Handling if attempts to update an Ethernet switch port with a MAC security entity configuration and the establishment of a transmit secure channel has been finalized Status: DRAFT If EthSwt_MacSecUpdateSecY was called for an EthSwtPort with EthSwtPort- MacSecEnabled set to TRUE and the update process for the corresponding Ether- net switch port with the MAC security entity configuration and the establishment of a transmit secure channel has been successfully finalized, then the EthSwt driver shall notify the EthIf by calling EthIf_SwitchMacSecUpdateSecYNotification with Result set to E_OK . Otherwise the EthSwt driver shall call EthIf_SwitchMacSe- cUpdateSecYNotification with Result set to E_NOT_OK .
